senses.gloss: m. st. constr. (חלף) in place of, instead.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 21:24">Targ. Ex. XXI, 24</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 129a:14">Sabb. 129ᵃ</cite> <he>נפשא ח׳ נפשא</he> life for life (meat is required after bloodletting), <he>סומקא ח׳ סומקא</he> red (wine) for red (blood).—Pl. <cite ref="H00785"><he>חֲלָפֵי</he></cite>, with suffix <cite ref="H01105"><he>חֲלָפוֹי</he></cite> in his place.

Targ. Prov. XI, 8 Ms. (ed. תחותוהי, ed. Lag. both words).—חֲלַף סִדְרָא f. (an adaptation of κλεψύδρα) [change of order,] clepsydra, a water clock used in courts of justice for measuring the time given for argument.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49:14">Gen. R. s. 49</cite> (not <cite ref="O01538"><he>סרדה</he></cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 83:12">Yalk. ib. 83</cite>.
